description: What ui/tests/plan-draft.test.mjs and plan-view.test.mjs must notice of the logic of the plan-mode page (P9 ac-11): the owner's draft of a plan, what it saves, whose the status and the evidence of a step are, the merge and the conflict when the plan moves on and the two ways out (ui/src/lib/plan-draft.ts); which request is a plan, what its card shows and which revision an approval answers, the Plan flag of the composer, the line of the banner and the head of the Plan tab (ui/src/lib/plan-view.ts); and the owner's feedback in the history of approvals (ui/src/lib/task-view.ts). The components are not mutated here: their tests (ui/tests/plan-components.test.mjs) bundle them with esbuild, which needs node_modules.
